platforms.name: search_ad
platforms.label: Search Ad
platforms.style: Hyper-optimized headline, no emojis, strongest single benefit only, a headline not a sentence
platforms.angle: Lead with the single strongest benefit as a direct, action-oriented answer to high purchase intent (e.g. 'solves X', 'get Y now') — outcome and urgency framing, not a general value statement

platforms.name: social_ad
platforms.label: Social Ad
platforms.angle: Spark an emotional, lifestyle reaction: how it feels to use, not a spec list

platforms.name: display_banner
platforms.label: Display Banner
platforms.angle: State who this is for and why they should trust it — a credibility, quality, or audience-fit signal (materials, reputation, who it suits), for someone passively browsing rather than searching. Avoid restating a benefit or outcome claim; lead with trust or fit instead
